about: Tech jobs through time: US backbone with an India and global thread. Every figure has a source; sec=1 marks a secondary source; est=1 marks our own estimate or arithmetic. Real dollars use CPI-U annual averages (BLS) to 2024 dollars.

roles.name: AI engineer
roles.note: No. 1 on LinkedIn Jobs on the Rise 2025 (US).

roles.name: Prompt engineer
roles.note: A 2023 posting at up to $335,000 made headlines; by May 2025 coverage called the title obsolete.

roles.name: AI red-teamer / safety evaluator
roles.note: Our reading: grew with frontier-model safety testing.

roles.name: Data scientist
roles.note: Glassdoor's 'best job in America' 2016–2019; work is shifting toward ML and AI engineering (our reading).

roles.name: Data engineer
roles.note: Our reading: grew with cloud data warehouses and pipelines.

roles.name: ML engineer
roles.note: Our reading: the production side of data science, now merging into AI engineering.

roles.name: DevOps → platform engineer
roles.note: Our reading: DevOps (from 2009) became platform engineering from about 2020.

roles.name: Site reliability engineer
roles.note: Started at Google in 2003; spread after Google's SRE book (2016).

roles.name: Cloud architect
roles.note: Our reading: grew with AWS, Azure and Google Cloud.

roles.name: Blockchain / web3 developer
roles.note: Our reading: boomed with crypto in 2017 and 2021, shrank after the 2022 crash.

roles.name: Flash developer
roles.note: Adobe ended Flash Player support on 31 Dec 2020.

roles.name: On-premises sysadmin
roles.note: Our reading: work moved to cloud and platform teams.

roles.name: Manual QA tester
roles.note: Our reading: automated testing absorbed much of it; BLS still counts QA analysts and testers (median $102,610, 2024).

roles.name: Entry-level software developer
roles.note: Employment of 22–25-year-old software developers fell about 20% from late 2022 (Stanford Digital Economy Lab).

roles.name: Webmaster
roles.note: One person ran a company website end to end in the early web; the job split into web developer, designer and content roles. Approximate dates, our reading; detailed figures come in the later parts of the series.

roles.name: Web developer
roles.note: Grew with the web and later split into front-end, back-end and full-stack roles. Approximate dates, our reading; detailed figures come in the later parts of the series.

roles.name: Mobile app developer
roles.note: Born with the iPhone App Store (July 2008) and Android Market (October 2008). Approximate dates, our reading; detailed figures come in the later parts of the series.

roles.name: Security analyst
roles.note: Grew with networked business systems; cloud and AI widened the job. Approximate dates, our reading; detailed figures come in the later parts of the series.

roles.name: Chip design engineer
roles.note: From the first microprocessors (Intel 4004, 1971) to AI accelerators; tools moved from hand layout to EDA software. Approximate dates, our reading; detailed figures come in the later parts of the series.

roles.name: UX designer
roles.note: "User experience" became a job title in the 1990s; AI tools are changing the work. Approximate dates, our reading; detailed figures come in the later parts of the series.

roles.name: Product manager
roles.note: Software product management spread in the 1990s and 2000s. Approximate dates, our reading; detailed figures come in the later parts of the series.

roles.name: Mainframe / COBOL programmer
roles.note: Business programming on IBM mainframes; still needed to maintain old banking and government systems. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Systems analyst
roles.note: Turned business needs into specifications; the work moved into business analysis and product roles. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Embedded software engineer
roles.note: Software inside devices, cars and machines. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Game developer
roles.note: From arcade and home consoles to mobile and online games. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Back-end engineer
roles.note: Builds servers, APIs and databases behind web and mobile apps. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Full-stack developer
roles.note: Front end and back end in one role. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Test automation engineer (SDET)
roles.note: Writes automated tests; replaced much manual QA. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Database administrator
roles.note: Ran company databases; much of the work moved to managed cloud databases. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: BI / data analyst
roles.note: Reports and dashboards on company data. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: AI research scientist
roles.note: Invents new models and training methods; grew after deep learning took off. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Data labeler / annotator
roles.note: Labels data and rates model outputs for training. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Analytics engineer
roles.note: Models data in the warehouse with SQL and tools such as dbt. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: MLOps engineer
roles.note: Runs the pipelines that train, deploy and monitor models. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: AI agent engineer
roles.note: Builds and evaluates AI agents that use tools. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Keypunch operator
roles.note: Typed programs and data onto punched cards. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Computer operator
roles.note: Ran the machine room: tapes, printers and job queues. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Network administrator
roles.note: Ran office networks; much of it moved to the cloud and managed services. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: IT help desk / support
roles.note: Supports staff with PCs, accounts and software. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Data centre technician
roles.note: Installs and repairs servers; demand grew with AI data centres. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: GPU / AI infrastructure engineer
roles.note: Builds and runs GPU clusters for training and serving. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Front-end engineer
roles.note: Builds rich browser apps. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Social media manager
roles.note: Runs company accounts on social platforms. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Growth hacker
roles.note: Start-up title for growth experiments; merged back into product and marketing. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: WordPress / CMS developer
roles.note: Builds sites on content systems; site builders took much of the work. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Low-code / no-code builder
roles.note: Builds apps and automations with visual tools. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Penetration tester
roles.note: Attacks systems with permission to find weaknesses. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Chief information security officer
roles.note: Executive in charge of security. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: SOC analyst
roles.note: Watches alerts in a security operations centre; AI tools are changing the work. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Cloud security engineer
roles.note: Secures cloud accounts, identities and networks. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Privacy engineer
roles.note: Builds data-protection controls; grew after GDPR (2018). Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Hardware engineer
roles.note: Designs computer hardware and boards. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Semiconductor process engineer
roles.note: Runs chip-making processes in fabs; new fabs are raising demand. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Minicomputer engineer
roles.note: Built minicomputers (DEC, Data General); the PC and Unix servers replaced them. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: FPGA engineer
roles.note: Designs logic for programmable chips. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Chip verification engineer
roles.note: Tests chip designs before manufacture. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: AI accelerator architect
roles.note: Designs chips for AI (GPUs, TPUs and custom accelerators). Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Technical writer
roles.note: Writes manuals and documentation; AI tools now draft much of it. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Technical support engineer
roles.note: Solves customer technical problems. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Program manager
roles.note: Coordinates large projects across teams. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: UI / web designer
roles.note: Designs screens and websites. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Developer advocate
roles.note: Helps developers use a company’s platform. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Customer success manager
roles.note: Keeps software customers successful and renewing. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Product designer
roles.note: Designs whole product experiences, not just screens. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: AI product manager
roles.note: Product manager for AI features and agents. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Software development engineer (SDE)
roles.note: The title Microsoft and Amazon use for software engineers (SDE I, II, III), copied by many big-tech and Indian employers; the same job as "software engineer" under another name. Hiring peaked in 2021–22 and AI coding tools are now changing the work. Approximate dates, our reading.

roles.name: Forward deployed engineer (FDE)
roles.note: An engineer who works inside the customer’s environment to make the product deliver; usually traced to Palantir in the mid-2000s (origin firm well supported, year approximate). AI labs and start-ups made it one of the fastest-growing titles of 2025–26.

roles.name: Product builder
roles.note: One person who designs, specifies and builds a product with AI tools. LinkedIn replaced its Associate Product Manager programme with an Associate Product Builder programme; strong performers may continue as Full Stack Builders.

roles.name: Management consultant
roles.note: Less desk research, more judgement and client work as AI takes analyst tasks (our reading).

roles.name: Junior business analyst / associate
roles.note: PwC US planned to cut graduate hiring by about a third; UK Big Four executives expected graduate hiring to fall by about half.

roles.name: SAP / ERP consultant
roles.note: Born with the 1990s ERP wave and Y2K replacements; now AI-assisted migrations (our reading).

roles.name: Offshore delivery manager
roles.note: Coordinates large offshore teams; the middle of the services pyramid is where cuts fall (our reading).

roles.name: Onsite coordinator
roles.note: The onshore link for an offshore team (our reading).

roles.name: GCC engineer (India)
roles.note: India had 2,117 global capability centres with 2.36 million staff in FY26 (Nasscom–Zinnov via Business Today).

roles.name: AI transformation consultant
roles.note: Consulting firms advertise more AI implementation roles while overall postings fell ~20% from peak (Revelio via secondary).

merges.note: LinkedIn's Associate Product Builder programme replaced its APM track: one hybrid product and engineering role.
A new role split off software and solutions work: postings up more than 1,000% in Jan–Aug 2026 vs 2025 (Lightcast via Fortune).
Testing folded into developers' work with AI-generated tests. Widely claimed; no count found (our reading).
Analysts writing SQL and pipelines with AI help (our reading).
Security and safety research grew a specialist AI testing role (our reading; no count found).
Management and coordination layers cut: 41% of employees say their organisation removed layers (Korn Ferry Workforce 2025).
Work moves from rented vendor teams to company-owned GCCs; GCCs added ~2× the net staff of IT services in FY26 (Nasscom–Zinnov via secondary).
Analyst work done with AI; firms hire fewer juniors and more AI implementation staff (secondary reports).
Implementation work increasingly done by the technology vendor's own embedded engineers (our reading).
